title: WASD Bake for Blender
cue: bake materials, occlusion, and high-poly detail to textures
summary: Texture baking in one call: node materials become color, roughness, metal, and normal images with shaded creases; a detailed model's surface goes onto a simple one; occlusion goes into vertex colors.
useWhen: A Blender model's node materials, which glTF cannot carry and Godot shows white, must become textures, and it has metal parts, which a plain bake turns black, or several materials, or needs occlusion in its creases; or a detailed sculpt should become a light model that keeps its look.
avoidWhen: The model already has image textures on a UV map without overlaps, such as a Poly Haven texture, unless it needs crease shading, which vertex_ao adds without touching them; or it has one plain material without metal and needs no crease shading, which a plain bpy.ops.object.bake covers.
